subject: Which licence to choose to publish source code ?

messages.author: 4753f061948056b3
messages.subject: Which licence to choose to publish source code ?
parts:
Hi Shiny-discuss,

We want to put some apps on free access over the web.
We want to put our web pages (understand the access to the apps under
our URL) under a CC-BY licence, but the source code on github under a
more code-fitted licence.

My question is : is there a licence that we are forced to used when
publishing code of shiny apps over the web (the source code, not the web
page of the animated app) or are we free to decide which one we want to
use ?

Thanks for advises.
